content: cert-manager Cloudflare DNS-01: API token needs Zone:DNS:Edit plus Zone:Zone:Read (zone.list permission errors otherwise); in split-DNS environments the self-check fails because cert-manager uses /etc/resolv.conf recursive nameservers (cluster DNS -> Mikrotik) which serve internal answers or block TXT lookups — fix with --dns01-recursive-nameservers=1.1.1.1:53,8.8.8.8:53 and --dns01-recursive-nameservers-only. Propagation check failures manifest as certs stuck in 'propagation check failed'. Sources: cert-manager docs + issues 6572/3234/5917/4624.
